answer.summary: The API types check failed because the generated TypeScript types are out of date. The change adds inject_execution_threshold_minutes settings to the API but the generated types were not regenerated and committed. This is deterministic and will repeat on re-run. Fix: run yarn generate-types-from-api and commit the result.
